templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from baseline-vs-ours by the note-writer: one integrated architecture, not two contrasted panels, where every added component is coloured orange against an all-white existing backdrop, and userspace/kernel form a mirrored pair rather than a baseline/ours split.
templates.what_to_learn: Colour every component the paper adds in one consistent accent (orange here) against an all-white backdrop for everything reused unchanged, so novelty reads at a glance across a single dense diagram; add an in-figure legend for the colour and arrow-style key, since this figure relies on caption text the extraction even cut off.
